records.title: On Balance Volume
records.formula: OBV_t=OBV_(t−1)+V_t if C_t>C_(t−1); −V_t if lower; unchanged if equal; initial seed arbitrary and must be declared.
records.researchNote: OBV: declared zero seed; successive completed close direction determines signed volume; arbitrary level not absolute money flow.

records.title: Accumulation Distribution Line
records.formula: CLV=(2C−H−L)/(H−L) for H>L; MoneyFlowVolume=CLV×V; ADL_t=ADL_(t−1)+MoneyFlowVolume; declare H=L handling.
records.researchNote: ADL: close-location multiplier uses completed H/L/C and bar volume; H=L zero treatment declared; not signed transaction flow.

records.title: Chaikin Money Flow
records.formula: CMF(N,t)=Σ_{last N completed bars}(CLV_i×V_i)/Σ_{last N completed bars}V_i, CLV=(2C−H−L)/(H−L); declare zero-range convention and nonzero aggregate volume.
records.researchNote: CMF: 20 completed-bar sum of CLV-volume / aggregate volume; zero total volume undefined; not exact trade buying pressure.

records.title: Money Flow Index
records.researchNote: MFI: 14 completed changes of typical price with positive and negative raw money flow; rising, falling, unchanged cases; 0/0 is neutral by explicit convention only.

records.title: Chaikin Oscillator
records.researchNote: Chaikin: EMA3 minus EMA10 of ADL with SMA seeds; competing platforms may use different seeds; not an actual order-flow tape.

records.title: Percentage Volume Oscillator
records.researchNote: PVO: EMA12 minus EMA26 of bar volume divided by EMA26 times 100; reject zero denominator.

records.title: Force Index
records.researchNote: Force Index: one-bar close change times completed bar volume, price-share units; no inference of trade aggressor.

records.title: Volume by Price or Volume Profile
records.formula: Sum volume into chosen price intervals; allocation method depends on feed
records.researchNote: Volume Profile: test uses close-price bins as ORIGINAL proxy; neither accurate volume at price nor real executed depth.

records.title: Price Relative Strength versus Benchmark
records.researchNote: Price Relative: same-time adjusted security price over matched adjusted benchmark price; corporate action and currency alignment pending.

records.title: StockCharts Technical Rank
records.formula: Proprietary vendor-defined scoring system; consult current provider documentation
records.researchNote: SCTR: StockCharts provider-relative universe rank, no original numerical reconstruction without approved vendor methodology, universe, licensed dataset and release review.

records.title: Advance Decline Line
records.researchNote: Advance-Decline: cumulated daily universe advancers minus decliners with explicit initial zero; universe and unchanged treatment must match.

records.title: New 52-Week Highs Minus Lows
records.researchNote: New Highs-Lows: eligible same-universe 52-week highs less 52-week lows; membership/split conventions held.

records.title: McClellan Oscillator
records.researchNote: McClellan: original case uses StockCharts ratio-adjusted breadth scaled x1000, EMA19/EMA39 seeded with SMA; raw net-advances variant different.

records.title: Percent Above Moving Average
records.researchNote: Percent Above MA: count eligible securities over their corresponding completed moving average divided by eligible universe; missing values must be excluded.

records.title: Put Call Volume Ratio
records.formula: Put/call traded-volume ratio = matching-period put options contract volume / matching-period call options contract volume; denominator must be >0.
records.researchNote: Put/Call: matching period and venue traded option contract volumes; zero call denominator undefined; not open interest or stock share volume.
